The '''''Leviathan''''' was a famous [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]] that served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as an anti-[[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. The ''Leviathan'' was given expanded [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bays to allow it to carry sixty [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and, under the command of the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Trence Vosh]], the ''Leviathan'' was sent by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to patrol trade routes and enforce the Republic's trade laws. However, during the Republic's last [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the Senate often was unable to reach a consensus as to where the ''Leviathan'' should be sent and as a result, the ship frequently had no official mission other than to patrol [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in search of pirates.
